rebeccaallen.memorable: Allen went undrafted, reached the WNBA after helping Australia win bronze at the 2014 FIBA World Cup, then built a 10-season WNBA career and returned to New York in 2026 for a second Liberty chapter.
rebeccaallen.offCourt: Away from the court, Allen completed a Master’s degree in Marketing at Deakin University and joined the NBL commentary team for the 2024–25 season, adding broadcasting to her basketball résumé.
